name: ramble
description: Author Ramble videos headlessly from Claude: re-anchor script to stable word-IDs, draft on-brand HTML slides (v10 design system + exemplar library), generate AI voiceover, and produce the video — all in your Ramble account.

ramble_token.title: Ramble token
